description: The Global Forest Resources Assessment is FAO's periodic worldwide assessment of forests, and the page describes the 2025 edition as the only worldwide assessment based on official national data. It reports long-term trends in forest resources in relation to goals on biodiversity, climate and sustainable land use, and is published as a main report, country reports for each reporting country and an interactive story. The underlying national data are served through the FRA data platform (fra-data.fao.org). The FRA programme also lists remote sensing surveys (FRA 2020 Remote Sensing Survey, the 2010 and 2015 global surveys and the 1990 and 2000 pan-tropical surveys) and historical world forest inventories back to 1948. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): FAO terms: statistical databases fall under the FAO Open Data Licensing Policy and Statistical Databases Terms of Use (licence of this database not named on the pages read). Access is free of charge. Caveats: values are country-reported and aggregated to national level, with definitions that change between editions, and the data platform is rendered by script. For green infrastructure analysis it gives harmonised national forest area, change and management statistics that can be used as context for nature-based protection and land-cover scenarios.
